resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-11-01T10:00:00-07:00, a buyout of one founder by the other is formally announced to the twelve employees (e.g., via an all-hands meeting, email, or official communication). Otherwise resolve NO.
